caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, brown ceramic jar with two rounded handles, one on each side near the top of the vessel. The surface of the jar is textured with a mottled appearance featuring various shades of brown, highlighting the rounded shape and volume of the jar. The jar has a wide body that tapers toward a slightly narrower base and a short, slightly flared neck. The top opening of the jar is outlined with a faint, dashed line, suggesting either unfinished work or a transparent guide for the mouth's shape. The drawing is centered within a lightly sketched rectangular border on a light, off-white paper background. Near the lower right corner of the image, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
